description: Five-layer DLoop+DFlash2 drafter with full verified-prefix FP32 KV, absolute-position RoPE and fixed/pruned DARTree proposals (at most 15 draft nodes plus anchor). Requires a version-2 L5/context_window=0 sidecar; no truncated-context fallback. TP2 exact row collectives and committed host tree verification; FP32 activations/accumulators over BF16 weights, reordered lossless reductions.
